deadline.value: Priority is given to applications in the office by January 15, 2027; later applications are accepted if space is available.
deadline.quote: Priority is given to applications that are in our office by January 15th, 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No faculty contact is needed to apply or be accepted; advisers are chosen after admission.
supervisor.quote: You do not need to contact faculty to apply or be accepted into the program.

funding.value: First-year PhD support is a GTA and tuition waiver for accepted students; later support depends on the adviser.
funding.quote: support in the first year for a PhD student will be in the form of a Graduate Teaching Assistantship (GTA) and a tuition waiver

entry_route.value: An MS is not needed to apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: You do not need to hold an MS degree to apply to our PhD programs.

gre_general.value: The program says GRE scores are not required.

toefl_min.value: The program requires a TOEFL total of 90, an old-scale iBT score, so no number is recorded.
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL total score of 90 is required with a minimum speaking score of 26

ielts_min.value: The program requires an IELTS total of 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: A total minimum score of 7.0 is required on the IELTS exam

notes: The graduate program is in Interdisciplinary Programs and is listed under Materials Science on the official list.
name: Ph.D. in Materials Science and Engineering
